title: Super Item Zene
description: The mod adds (for now) four sets of armor and tools. It also includes an ore that can be used to obtain ingots of a new material called Zenium.
body:
# Super Items Zene 🌌🔥🧪

Welcome to Super Items Zene, an endgame expansion that overhauls your survival progression! This mod introduces a high-tier ecosystem of unique resources, ultimate sets of enchanted gear, and innovative survival mechanics. Embark on a journey from a rookie miner to a powerful warrior, mastering cosmic space and hellish heat.

## 💎 Features

### 🌌 Tier 1 & 2: The Aymond Progression
Discover Aymond, a rare and powerful cosmic crystal found in the world.
* **Base Set:** Craft highly durable weapons, armor, and tools that surpass traditional diamond gear.
* **Enhanced Set:** Take your gear to the next level. Crafting Enhanced Aymond tools automatically bestows them with permanent, high-tier enchantments (Efficiency V and Unbreaking III) straight from survival crafting!

### 🌋 Tier 3: Nether Aymond & End Aymond
Take your Aymond tools into other dimensions. Upgrade your gear using hellish alloys and ender blocks to create the ultra-fast and incredibly durable Nether Aymond and End Aymond weapon tiers.

### 🖤 The Zenium Element & True Damage
Delve into the deepest, hottest layers of the Nether to discover Zenium Ore.
* **Zenium Sword:** Forged from high-grade hell steel, this weapon possesses the terrifying ability to deal True Magic Damage, completely bypassing conventional armor defenses.
* **Zenium Armor Set:** Heavy armor plates that grant the wearer absolute immunity to fire and lava damage, allowing you to safely explore the Nether's lava lakes.
